"It is simply one of the best maths apps we have seen." - PCAdvisor UK

"This kind of programming really enlivens play, and keeps kids ready and alert." -TeachersWithApps

"One of the best features of this app is the data collection." - funeducationalapps

Have your students practice and learn addition, subtraction, division, times tables and basic problem solving with Monster Math Pro! Be Maxx’s personal math helper as you explore new worlds, battle enemies and find allies in unexpected places by using addition, multiplication, subtraction and division!

Walk your students through basic mental math and drills built into Monster Math’s interactive playing board. Unlike flash cards or simple quiz based apps, Monster Math’s core game mechanics are designed to quiz multiple skills at once and guide kids towards answers.

Monster Math also provides a unique story and adaptive game play to tutor kids at a suitable pace. Have your kids progress through learning their core math skills and times tables while helping Maxx find Dextra! Kids love Monster Math!

Monster Math Features:
Tons of Adventure
• Be Maxx’s helper as he searches for his best friend Dextra! Your child can follow the engaging voice-over narration as they run through multiple worlds and levels. Practice basic problem solving in dozens of different levels to defeat enemy Troggles and Minions!

Learn and Practice Arithmetic
• Monster Math is better than homework, and it’s the perfect math trainer for your child. Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication and division with Maxx! Monster Math’s multilevel system is designed to guide struggling kids towards the right answers.

Challenging Drills and Quizzes
• This math trainer adjusts in difficulty depending on your child’s progression. Pace of drills quickens or slows depending on how do with addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. 

Multiplayer Mode
• Play along with your child or have them play with others online and around the world through GameCenter! Children will love the competition and motivation to win. 

Practice Mode
• This no-nonsense mode is for your children to keep learning without the pressure of having to run from Troggles and Minions! Run through all the basic skills that may even appear in your child’s homework!

In-Depth Reporting
• Learn how your child is doing with the Common Core Standards for math. See where they
need help and know what skills they do well in. You can even get a skill-by-skill analysis.
